description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance Call Out with effect from August 22, 2022 all the members of the Armed Forces
reasoning: This gazette content is an order issued by the President under the Public Security Ordinance, calling out the armed forces for the maintenance of public order. It constitutes a legal/regulatory action, specifically the exercise of statutory powers to deploy military forces, which falls under the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters, including statutory instruments and orders.
